options.description: ***string*** - the Fully Qualified Domain Name for your Rancher Server
***string*** - Where to get the cert for the ingress. - "***rancher, letsEncrypt, secret***"
***string*** - Your email address
***string*** - Valid options: "***staging, production***"
***bool*** - Set to true if your cert is signed by a private CA
***bool*** - [See Additional Trusted CAs Server](https://rancher.com/docs/rancher/v2.x/en/installation/options/chart-options/#additional-trusted-cas)
***string*** - As of Rancher v2.5.0 this flag is deprecated and must be set to "true"
***string*** - AntiAffinity rule for Rancher pods - *"preferred, required"*
***int*** - Number of replicas of Rancher pods
***string*** - Stream to sidecar container console or hostPath volume - *"sidecar, hostPath"*
***string*** - log file destination on host (only applies when **auditLog.destination** is set to **hostPath**)
***int*** - set the [API Audit Log level](https://rancher.com/docs/rancher/v2.x/en/installation/api-auditing). 0 is off. [0-3]
***int*** - maximum number of days to retain old audit log files (only applies when **auditLog.destination** is set to **hostPath**)
int - maximum number of audit log files to retain (only applies when **auditLog.destination** is set to **hostPath**)
***int*** - maximum size in megabytes of the audit log file before it gets rotated (only applies when **auditLog.destination** is set to **hostPath**)
***string*** - Image location for busybox image used to collect audit logs *Note: Available as of v2.2.0*
***string*** - Override imagePullPolicy for busybox images - *"Always", "Never", "IfNotPresent"*
***bool*** - set debug flag on rancher server
***string*** - set cert-manager compatibility
***list*** - set additional environment variables for Rancher Note: *Available as of v2.2.0*
***list*** - list of names of Secret resource containing private registry credentials
***bool*** - install ingress resource
***bool*** - Add default nginx annotations
***map*** - additional annotations to customize the ingress
***string*** - Add additional Nginx configuration. Can be used for proxy configuration. Note: *Available as of v2.0.15, v2.1.10 and v2.2.4*
***string*** - optional ingress class for the cert-manager acmesolver ingress that responds to the Let’s *Encrypt ACME challenges*
***string** - HTTP[S] proxy server for Rancher
***string*** - comma separated list of hostnames or ip address not to use the proxy
***map*** - rancher pod resource requests & limits
***string*** - rancher image source
***string*** - rancher/rancher image tag
***string*** - Override imagePullPolicy for rancher server images - *"Always", "Never", "IfNotPresent"*
***string*** - See External TLS Termination for details. - *"ingress, external"*
***string*** - private registry to be used for all system Docker images, e.g., [http://registry.example.com/] *Available as of v2.3.0*
***bool*** - select to use the system-charts packaged with Rancher server. This option is used for air gapped installations.  *Available as of v2.3.0*

***bool*** - Enabled [Ember Rancher UI (cluster manager) custom logos](https://github.com/rancher/ui/tree/master/public/assets/images/logos) and [Vue Rancher UI (cluster explorer) custom logos](https://github.com/rancher/dashboard/tree/master/assets/images/pl) persistence volume
***string*** - Volume subpath for [Ember Rancher UI (cluster manager) custom logos](https://github.com/rancher/ui/tree/master/public/assets/images/logos) persistence
***string*** - Volume subpath for [Vue Rancher UI (cluster explorer) custom logos](https://github.com/rancher/dashboard/tree/master/assets/images/pl) persistence
***string*** - Use an existing volume. Custom logos should be copied to the proper `volume/subpath` folder by the user. Optional for persistentVolumeClaim, required for configMap
***string*** - Set custom logos persistentVolumeClaim storage class. Required for dynamic pv
***string*** - Set custom persistentVolumeClaim access mode
***string*** - Set custom persistentVolumeClaim size
